summary: Renasant Corp filed an 8-K reporting a $300M 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes offering via an underwriting agreement with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods and Stephens Inc. The notes were issued at 100% of par, closing May 7, 2026, with net proceeds of ~$295.7M after discounts. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including potential redemption of $40M of its 5.50% notes due 2031. This is a routine capital markets transaction under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation; no change of control, activism, restructuring, or strategic event is involved.
